sourceAuthority: POLY ALPHA HUNTER v4 (reconciled via #POLY-G8.4 spec, #POLY-G10, and #POLY-G10.5 global-first strategic rebaseline)

stages.name: Audit, Data Ingest & Key Isolation
acceptanceConditions: 5-repo architecture and license matrix verified
Written Polymarket data-rights clearance obtained
Approved collector budget covers verified VPS+R2+ops cost
Linux systemd runtime and live R2 SHA-256 read-back verified
>=150 eligible markets captured for 7 continuous qualifying days
Read-only no-trading security proof verified

stages.name: Execution Simulator & Baseline (Gate 1)
acceptanceConditions: Deterministic point-in-time Parquet replay with zero lookahead
Conservative behind-queue maker simulation with partial fills and cancel delay
CLOB V2 dynamic fee precision (5-decimal rounding) verified
Reproducible baseline backtest on genuine eligible L2 data (no synthetic-only PASS)

stages.name: Anchored Walk-Forward & Adversarial Stress
acceptanceConditions: >=30 continuous qualifying days of L2 data
Chronological train/calibration/test split across 4 regimes
Parameter sensitivity +/-20% and Regime/OFI/Queue ablations
1.5x cost/slippage stress, 1.5x cancel latency stress, 50% reward haircut
Bootstrap 95% CI LB > 0 and Deflated Sharpe >= 1.5

stages.name: Live Data Paper/Shadow & Calibration (Gate 2)
acceptanceConditions: >=14 real days of paper/shadow observation
Live feed vs replay calibration and 5s/60s/300s maker markout
Multi-leg partial-fill and unwind completion >= 92%
>=150 genuinely resolved prospective OOS forecasts (BSS_OOS >= +0.02, ECE < 0.035) before unlocking w_skill > 0
Independent Maker, NegRisk, and AI/News gate verdicts

stages.name: Shadow Verification & Conditional Micro-Pilot
acceptanceConditions: Jurisdiction-aware operator, entity, and venue eligibility clearance (OPERATOR_JURISDICTION_ELIGIBILITY & LEGAL_G12)
IC economic clearance (ECONOMIC_G11)
Explicit Founder sign-off (FOUNDER_G13)
Heartbeat 10s, HTTP 425 cooldown, GhostGuard emergency-stop, and ExchangeV3 signing drills passed

stages.name: Capacity, Tail Risk & Investment Decision (Gate 3)
acceptanceConditions: Capacity curve and marginal execution cost across deployable tiers
Separated MTM, Realized, and Settled PnL reporting
99% CVaR, event concentration, UMA dispute risk, and infra cost drag modeled
Explicit IC resolution: SCALE (requires new approval) | HOLD | REJECT
